plugin.name: Animations
plugin.description: Adds many new animation presets to be used by game characters, and replaces one previously unused animation with a new one that makes using the blacksmith series of animations (forging a blade) usable. The animations are not perfect (there is some clipping and NPC's don't use the hammer correctly), but it's still much better than nothing. Besides, unless you position your camera right next to the NPC blacksmith, you won't even notice anything's off.

plugin.name: Materials - Main
plugin.description:
Requirements: 1.3 Tints - Custom ;
Adds several new materials to the game: Awakening materials for Origins (White Steel, Volcanic Aurum, Dragon Wing, High Dragon Hide, Vhenadahl, and Ancestral Heartwood), Golderite (better than Silverite but worse than Dragonbone), Blue Steel (marginally better than Dragonbone), Dragonscale (between White Steel and Volcanic Aurum), Fade Metal (similar to Golderite but lighter) and Elder Dragonbone (marginally better than Volcanic Aurum). It also makes wood available to be used on weapons, such as the staves. Additionally, a more detailed or accurate description of some item enchantments & properties (increased mana/stamina, increased chance to avoid missile attacks, reduced aim time, etc.) is provided.

plugin.name: Materials - Optional
plugin.description: Contains several changes done to material stats. Although it's not recommended, these changes may be reversed by deleting the GDA files containing them or by deleting the entire folder. The changes are as follows: - Starmetal was turned into one of the best materials in the game. Only Volcanic Aurum can stand up to it, which is better than Starmetal in some ways, but worse in others. (contained in materialrules_gwb.GDA) - Starmetal was given a completely new tint. (contained in materialtypes_gwb.GDA) - Lowered strength or dexterity requirements of Tier 8 and Tier 9 materials so they can be used by Origins characters. (contained in materialrules_gxa.gda) - All Awakening materials were given a completely new tint, made from scratch. (contained in materialtypes_gxa.GDA) - Material progression used for Darkspawn weapons has been changed from Iron/Grey Iron/Steel to Iron/Grey Iron/Red Steel/Dragonbone. (contained in TS_Material_IA.GDA)

plugin.name: Tints - Custom
plugin.description: New tints that don't outright replace any vanilla ones. Even if you're using a different tint mod, do not delete this folder if you're also using "1.4. Items", as the tints here are needed for some custom items to look properly.

plugin.name: Tints - Replacers
plugin.description:
Requirements: 1.3 Tints - Custom;
As the name implies, these replace certain vanilla material tints, which are: Red Steel, Silverite, Dragonbone, Inscribed Leather, Drakescale Leather, and Dragonthorn. If you have a mod which also replaces these tints, and you would like to keep them, you may delete this folder.

plugin.name: Items
Areas
plugin.description:
Requirements: 1.1 Animations, 2.4 Conversations, 2.5 Scripts;
Modified modules – this is the heart of the mod, the reason I started this project. If you want NPC's to behave more realistically (they'll be moving around, resting, sitting, etc.), more party banter triggers, party picker enabled in more areas and so much more, you’ll want to leave this in your override

plugin.name: Characters
plugin.description:
Requirements: 1.2 Materials, 1.3 Tints - Custom, 1.4 Items;
The character (.utc) files in this folder mostly dictate what NPC’s wear. Almost all NPC’s in the game were given a different outfit: one that better suits their personalities and professions. Many NPC’s now also wear equipment that is no longer scaled, which means that not everyone will wear iron at the beginning or dragonbone near the end. Hopefully, this will make the game slightly more atmospheric, and give important NPC's the uniqueness they deserve.

plugin.name: Placeables
plugin.description:
Requirements: 1.2 Materials, 1.3 Tints - Custom, 1.4 Items;
Adds a few new items into certain crates, chests, closets or, in short, placeables.

plugin.name: Conversations
plugin.description:
Requirements: 1.1 Animations, 2.1 Areas, 2.5 Scripts;
Included are dialog files that were edited for bug fixes and restored lines. Additionally, a number of cutscenes and stages were also tweaked to be able to complement the new ambient behaviors.

plugin.name: Scripts

Rewards

plugin.name: PC Origins
plugin.description:
Requirements: 1.2 Materials, 1.3 Tints - Custom, 1.4 Items;
Files in these folders tweak each origin in a number of ways. I was not concerned about balance as much as I was about realism. So, yes, playing as a human or dwarf noble will make the beginning of the game easier (installing a difficulty mod is recommended), while playing as a commoner or a mage will make it harder (due to NPC’s wearing better unscaled equipment).

plugin.name: Dialog Changes
plugin.description: Modifies companion approval gain and some of their conversations and/or comments . It also fixes some bugs in companion's dialogs.

plugin.name: Gear Changes
Areas
plugin.description: Contains only two minor changes (thanks to no toolset available): in Amaranthine, fixes the Chanter's position, so that her feet do not clip through the nearby vase, and in The Wending Woods, replaces a generic baddie with a unique leader of the bandits.

plugin.name: Awakening Quick Items
plugin.description:
Requirements: 1.2 Materials, 1.3 Tints - Custom, 1.4 Items;
This will enrich your Origins experience with quick items (stamina potions and explosives), crafting ingredients, and recipes from Awakening. Stamina potions are especially useful if you happen to forget to bring a mage with you. You will find these items scattered across the game world. Defeated foes should sometimes drop a Stamina Draught. The rest of the items are available from various merchants—most of the explosives (traps, bombs, blade coatings) and their respective recipes will be sold by the Crows, while stamina potions as well as the recipes required to make them are sold by a large number of merchants who usually also sell health potions; keep your eyes peeled.

folder.source: Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.2. Awakening Quick Items
folder.destination: packages/core/override/Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.2. Awakening Quick Items

plugin.name: Alistair Climax Speech
plugin.description: If Alistair is on the throne but not in the party (because you spared Loghain), he will now deliver the pre-final battle speech in front of Denerim city gates instead of Anora. Why? Because Anora's screaming makes my ears bleed, and I reckon I'm not the only one.

folder.source: Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.3. Optional Campaign Mods/Alistair Climax Speech
folder.destination: packages/core/override/Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.3. Optional Campaign Mods/Alistair Climax Speech

plugin.name: Cammen & Gheyna Romances
plugin.description: Unlocks Cammen's and Gheyna's mini romance for both genders. It works well for the most part. There is only one instance where your PC is not correctly referred to, and it only happens if you're a male who slept with Cammen and then told Gheyna about it. When it comes to journal entries, I rewrote the ones that mentioned your PC's gender, so you don't have to worry about that. Additionally, the quest can now be completed by sleeping with both, and you will lose (or gain) no approval with the clan (makes sense since neither wants to talk about what happened).

folder.source: Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.3. Optional Campaign Mods/Cammen & Gheyna Romances
folder.destination: packages/core/override/Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.3. Optional Campaign Mods/Cammen & Gheyna Romances

plugin.name: Release Jowan
plugin.description: This will make it possible to release Jowan even if you didn't already do so upon first meeting him. To do this, you have to tell Teagan you wish to execute Jowan yourself (I added a few extra lines for PC mages), and then, while speaking to Jowan, you will be presented with an option to let him go. The remainder of his quest then functions just as if you had released him when you first met him. Do note that once Eamon awakes, you will no longer have this option, so speak to Teagan about Jowan before you revive Eamon.

folder.source: Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.3. Optional Campaign Mods/Release Jowan
folder.destination: packages/core/override/Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.3. Optional Campaign Mods/Release Jowan

plugin.name: Varathorn Special Store
plugin.description: Varathorn's special store (which includes unique and quite powerful items) will now only unlock if you complete his Ironbark quest and side with the elves (either by killing the Wares or letting Zathrian to sacrifice himself). In vanilla, it unlocks after you complete three main quests, regardless of whether Nature of the Beast is one of them or not. I feel this makes it a bit more realistic. I mean, why would he trade his best items with a complete stranger? For all he knows, these weapons could at some point be used against his clan.

folder.source: Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.3. Optional Campaign Mods/Varathron Special Store
folder.destination: packages/core/override/Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.3. Optional Campaign Mods/Varathron Special Store

plugin.name: Bodies Stay
plugin.description: The bodies of your victims will no longer fade away. Now you can loot the Ogre without having to fear that its body will disappear in front of your eyes.

plugin.name: Bodies Stay - No Bones
plugin.description: This will overwrite vanilla bone models with invisible placeables, which basically means bodies won't turn into bones after a little while anymore, but will instead disappear completely. While this is meant to be used in conjunction with "Bodies Stay" mod, there's nothing stopping you from using this as an independent mod. Be warned, though, that doing so will make looting decayed corpses harder (I suggest pushing the "highlight useable objects" button), since they'll be invisible.

folder.source: Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.4. Bodies Stay/No Bones
folder.destination: packages/core/override/Improved Atmosphere/7. Extras/7.4. Bodies Stay/No Bones
